name: University of Waikato
description: The University of Waikato is a public university founded in 1964 in Hamilton, with a second campus in Tauranga. It teaches arts, business, computing, education, engineering, health, law, science and social sciences.
whyIncluded: The University of Waikato is among the 10 universities in New Zealand most chosen by international students (5,220 international students enrolled in 2025, Ministry of Education provider data), per the FinexisEdu shortlist research of October 2026.

livingCosts.summary: The university's own estimate for a student in a catered hall in Hamilton: room with meals, bus fares, phone, entertainment, textbooks and clothes. Excludes insurance, visa and flights.
livingCosts.notes: Waikato 'Cost of living' page (no year stated; 2026 = year read), Hamilton halls of residence column, weekly x 52/12. Housing: fully catered hall $446-$510/wk, midpoint $478 (meals included, so food is 0). Transport: public transport $15+/wk. Personal: mobile phone $10+ + entertainment $50+ per week ($260/month) plus annual textbooks and printing $500+ and clothes and toiletries $500+ ($83.33/month). Page's Hamilton weekly total $351-$635; self-catered halls $276-$332/wk. Excludes bond $450-$680, insurance from $855/yr, visa $700-$850 and flights. Minimum ('+') figures used where the page gives only a floor.
